name: data_platform
description: Owns the data warehouse, its pipelines and this catalog: ODS, marts, metrics and data quality.

name: regulatory_reporting
description: Prepares and submits the bank's reports to the Central Bank of Uzbekistan.

name: core_banking
description: Runs iABS, the core banking system: customer master, accounts, the core ledger, payments and deposits. Owns the iabs source.

name: cards_and_lending
description: Runs TranzAxis, the retail credit and card engine: credit lines, microloans, cards and card transactions. Owns the tranzaxis source.

name: digital_banking
description: Builds and runs the mobile banking app and its backend: app users, devices, KYC and logins. Owns the mobile source.
